mapper.insert: MERGE INTO WMS.TB_VEHICLE T USING ( SELECT #{srvcCd} AS SRVC_CD , #{whCd} AS WH_CD , #{vehicleNo} AS VEHICLE_NO , #{drvNm} AS DRV_NM , #{hpNo} AS HP_NO , #{tonClsCd} AS TON_CLS_CD , #{useYn} AS USE_YN , #{userId} AS USER_ID ) AS S ON (T.SRVC_CD = S.SRVC_CD AND T.WH_CD = S.WH_CD AND T.VEHICLE_NO = S.VEHICLE_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DRV_NM = S.DRV_NM , TON_CLS_CD = S.TON_CLS_CD , HP_NO = S.HP_NO , USE_YN = S.USE_YN , UPD_ID = S.USER_ID , UPD_DATE = NOW() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SRVC_CD , WH_CD , VEHICLE_NO , DRV_NM , HP_NO , TON_CLS_CD , USE_YN , REG_ID , REG_DATE ) VALUES ( S.SRVC_CD , S.WH_CD , S.VEHICLE_NO , S.DRV_NM , S.HP_NO , S.TON_CLS_CD , S.USE_YN , S.USER_ID , NOW() )
